title: Security Operations Centre and Data Centre Hardening

demo_extraction.scope_summary: Establish a 24x7 Security Operations Centre with SIEM and SOAR tooling. Harden data centre servers and storage, and conduct penetration testing. Supply network security appliances with three year OEM support.

eligibility.requirement: Valid NTN and active ATL status
eligibility.source_quote: The bidder must hold a valid National Tax Number (NTN) and appear on the FBR Active Taxpayers List (ATL).

eligibility.requirement: Minimum average annual turnover of PKR 45 million over the last three years.
eligibility.source_quote: Minimum average annual turnover of PKR 45 million over the last three years.
The bidder must hold a valid ISO 27001 certificate.

eligibility.requirement: Two CISSP or CISM certified staff
eligibility.source_quote: At least two staff members must hold CISSP or CISM certifications.
Authorized OEM partner letter for the proposed SIEM is required.
Affidavit on stamp paper that the bidder has not been blacklisted by any government body.
Bid security in the form of a pay order or bank guarantee shall accompany the financial bid.
